_readme: Golden fixtures for the planning agent. Pure data, so no attribution line.
planner_outputs is a queue: every entry but the last is expected to FAIL the
validator, exercising the single replan; the last is expected to pass.
test_planning_golden.py validates all of it through the real schemas at
collection time, so a drifted fixture fails loudly instead of passing a suite
